The crisis at the airports is Democrat-made.

Let's be VERY clear about this: these issues are because Chuck Schumer and the Democrats are trying to hold the security of our nation hostage so they can reinstate Biden-era immigration enforcement, which was no enforcement.

There is no way House Republicans are going to support that. That's INSANE.

Video

The Democrats have created a crisis for the American people who are just trying to live their lives because they don't want border enforcement in our country. 

It's NUTS. And we're not going to yield on that point. 

My full interview with @JulieMasonShow1 / @SIRIUSXM:

Video

It was great to be in Jacksonville with @DeanBlackFL & @NickHowland15 at Veterans United Craft Brewery!

Those who sacrificed everything for our country deserve nothing less than our full commitment. As Governor, I'll fight to make Florida the best state in the nation for our veterans.

We HAVE to enforce the law. 

What happened under Joe Biden and the Democrats was insane. They threw our country's borders wide open.

If you overstay your visa or are in the country illegally, you have to go home.

Video
Live from Jax: Veterans Roundtable nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1pJkOyMro…

Democrats are holding the safety and security of Americans hostage just to score political points against Trump.

These people are radical and unhinged. Their ideology does not support the American people, our Constitution, or Western civilization.

ENOUGH IS ENOUGH. End the filibuster, pass the spending bills, and get back to work for the American people.

Video

I don't know what the hell Democrats are looking for.

We'll go back to the table, but if all they're going to do is run to the floor and yell and whine because they want to return to Biden-era border security, they're out of their mind.

It's never going to happen. Not with my vote.

Video

The Democrat position on ICE is flat-out crazy and insane.

They want to go back to the Biden-era open borders disaster. Republicans and President Trump have negotiated in good faith, and it's fallen on deaf ears.

You can't negotiate with crazy, and Chuck Schumer's position is absolutely crazy.

Video

President Trump said it best at the SOTU: these Democrats are CRAZY. 

It's not just Democrats on the Hill. It's Democrat ideology top to bottom. 

Securing our nation should not be partisan. These Democrats want wide-open borders so they can have power. Plain and simple.

Video

America, how do you expect Republicans to negotiate with such stupidity??? 

END THE FILIBUSTER! 
FUND DHS! 
PASS THE SAVE AMERICA ACT!


Senator Mazie Hirono (@maziehirono)

Donald Trump is not, never will be, and has never been a king. #NoKings



— https://nitter.net/maziehirono/status/2037921404788847103#m

The Senate's bill was trash, and everyone knows it. 

The bill doesn't fund our border patrol agents, it degrades the mission of ICE, empowers drug cartels, and defunds the ability to investigate child sex trafficking. 

That's what Senate Democrats sent to the House, and we said NO.

My full interview with @ChrisStirewalt / @NewsNation:

Video

It was great to be in Charlotte County for the Lincoln Reagan Dinner last night.

Thank you to all the patriots who joined us for an incredible night.

Together, we will take Florida to the next level. 🇺🇸

Today, we remember the day Jesus entered Jerusalem.

Palm Sunday reminds us that true strength is found in humility, and our faith calls us to trust God even when the path ahead is unclear.

As we enter Holy Week, may we walk with intention, reflect with gratitude, and trust in the Lord.

Hosanna in the highest!

The House has consistently done its job in funding homeland security.

Senate Democrats have consistently blocked it because they want open borders.

Our agents deserve to be paid. Americans deserve to be safe. It's time for the Senate to get back to DC and finish the job.

Watch my full interview on @BigWeekendShow / @FoxNews :

Video

Please join me NEXT FRIDAY in Cape Coral for a Meet & Greet + Rally at Official Patriot Gear, where I’ll be sharing my vision for Florida with my friend @ConservativeAnt 

RSVP HERE: ByronDonalds.com/PatriotEven…

Bairon Hernandez was deported 4 times and had 15 criminal charges before he murdered an 83-year-old Air Force veteran.

He should never have been on the streets to begin with. Democrats didn't just let this happen. They fought for criminals to come into our country and stay here.

Democrats care more about the protection of criminal illegal aliens than they do American heroes like Richard Williams.
